title: 共同单词数
problem_statement_md: 输入两个句子，计算并输出共同的单词（两句中都有的词）的数量。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Sets[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Given two sentences, you need to find and output the number of the common words (words that are present in both sentences).

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
this is some text
I would like this tea and some cookies

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
2

The words '[b]some[/b]' and '[b]this[/b]' appear in both sentences.
[note]You can use the [b]split()[/b] function to get a list of words in a string and then use the [b]set()[/b] function to convert it into a set. For example, to convert the list [b]x[/b] to a set you can use: [b]set(x)[/b][/note]
hint_md: 你可以使用**split()**函数来获得一个字符串中的单词列表，然后使用**set()**函数将其转换为一个集合。例如，要将列表**x*转换为一个集合，可以使用：**set(x)**

code_templates.solution_code:
s1 = input() 
s2 = input() 

list1 = s1.split()
list2 = s2.split()

print(len(set(list1)&set(list2)))

testcases.stdin:
how are you doing my friend
he is a friend of my brother
testcases.explanation: 有2个共同的单词`friend` 和 `my`。
